config.wrapSingleStatementBodies.descrip: Dangerous rewrite: wrap single-statement if/while/for/else bodies in braces before formatting. Opt-in only because it increases line count.
config.splitMultiInstructions.descriptio: Dangerous rewrite: split multiple instructions on one line into separate statements before formatting.
config.splitDeclarationAssignment.descri: Dangerous rewrite: split local variable declarations with initializers into separate declaration and assignment statements when possible.
config.hoistDeclarationsToFunctionTop.de: Dangerous rewrite: move local variable declarations from nested scopes or late positions to the top of the function body.
config.rewriteForToWhile.description: Dangerous rewrite: convert for-loops into while-loops before formatting.

config.allowUnsafeTransforms.deprecation: Use the granular dangerous transform settings such as `normFormatter.wrapSingleStatementBodies`, `normFormatter.splitDeclarationAssignment`, and `normFormatter.rewriteForToWhile` instead.
